targets.intended_sense: successive, repeated, or continuous in a sequence
targets.note: The raw source English gloss is misleading for this teaching sense. Standard Urdu dictionary usage supports پے در پے، لگاتار، مسلسل; the learner-facing passage uses that standard sense.

targets.intended_sense: a strong wind or dust-storm event
a drop of liquid, here a raindrop
an agricultural field or cultivated plot
sweat or perspiration produced by the body
a pipe carrying water as part of urban infrastructure
an index combining indicators into a comparative measure
one quarter, or one of four equal parts
absent, vanished, or no longer existing; here locally disappeared
a means, method, way, or practical route to action
targets.note: Standard Urdu dictionary usage includes تدبیر، وسیلہ، ذریعہ، طریقہ in addition to other senses; the passage deliberately uses the means/method sense.
